definitions.PUB: Organic growth: net revenue growth at constant scope and FX. Margin: operating margin on net revenue.
definitions.OMC: Organic growth: revenue growth excluding acquisitions, disposals and FX. Margin: adjusted EBITA margin. Not comparable across the IPG close (Nov 2025).
definitions.WPP: Like-for-like revenue less pass-through costs growth. Margin: headline operating margin.
definitions.HAVAS: Organic net revenue growth. Margin: adjusted EBIT margin on net revenue.
definitions.DENTSU: Organic growth of net revenue. Margin: underlying operating margin.
definitions.STGW: Organic net revenue growth. Margin: adjusted EBITDA margin on net revenue.
